title: Openings.
officialText:
All openings shall be through the top of the storage tank, except that storage tanks of 275 gallon (1041 L)
capacity or less, located above ground but below the lowest story, may be provided with a 3/ -inch (19.1 mm) opening for gravity
4
discharge and a 1-inch (25 mm) opening in the bottom for cleaning and protection against corrosion.
